resources.text: Fictional game rules: sealed box B has no expiry. Opening B consumes it and grants token T, which expires at the end of day 7 after opening. T can be spent only in the current rotating shop. U has a sealed box and is waiting for next month's shop; there is no preview or guarantee of its contents. Keeping B sealed preserves the option; opening is irreversible in this sandbox. Calendar convention: t0 is on calendar day 1. Simulated action time does not advance calendar days; any calendar change would be stated explicitly.
